title: Plan executable P1-008 Staff OS control-view verification
businessObjective: Prepare one bounded, static, Tier 0 Staff OS control-view contract so P1-008 can be implemented and independently verified without creating a live Staff OS service, data integration, or production action.
technicalObjective: Define the finite V1 Staff OS control-view schema authority, committed artifact, exact validator command, failure behavior, documentation, and corrected P1-008 packet scope; do not implement any schema, artifact, validator, verifier admission, UI, or runtime capability.
assumptions: P1-008 remains a static, repository-local Tier 0 observe-only contract; it has no live data source, server, UI runtime, database, network access, credential, production write, workflow execution, authorization, approval, or audit-store behavior.
P1-002, P1-003, and P1-007 are completed finite authorities that P1-008 may reference but must not redefine, mutate, or treat as a production data source.

The existing P1-008 packet is not executable because its subsystem command and finite contract are unspecified; a separate governance packet must admit the exact future validator command only after the validator exists.
acceptanceCriteria: A durable design specifies exactly one closed V1 Staff OS control-view schema authority, one finite static artifact, and one deterministic Node validator with fail-closed malformed or mutated-artifact behavior.

The design fixes a Tier 0 observe-only view set that references only the static P1-002 control-plane contract, P1-003 append-only audit contract, and P1-007 deny-only kill-switch decision boundary; it introduces no live records, queries, data collection, or execution controls.
The P1-008 backlog packet is amended only to the designed static-contract scope and names the exact future Node validator command rather than the nonexistent npm test command.

The design states that a separate verifier-admission governance packet must admit only the exact future validator command with shell disabled and near-miss rejection coverage after implementation exists.

Independent QA can confirm that no Staff OS implementation, schema, artifact, validator, verifier change, CI workflow, runtime capability, protected path, or historical evidence was altered by this planning task.
requiredChecks: P1-008 packet scope and dependency review
exact future validator-command and verifier-admission review
solEscalationTriggers: Any proposal to add a live Staff OS UI, service, data query, data store, workflow behavior, mutable state, action control, authorization, approval, execution, external access, credential, production write, payment, booking, RLS, migration, or concurrency behavior.
Any ambiguity about the finite V1 authority, source-contract reference, or exact verifier admission.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only this planning document, the P1-008 backlog packet amendment, the GOV-036 lifecycle change, its risk entry, and its evidence; preserve completed records, canonical architecture sources, all P1-002/P1-003/P1-007 authorities, and all product/runtime surfaces.
